question: Where can I get renewable curtailment and redispatch volumes in Brazil, by zone or node and by period?

answer.summary: ONS publishes half-hourly wind and solar constrained-off estimates for covered plants or groups on Brazil's interconnected system (SIN). The CSVs give subsystem, state and connection point. Multiply each nonempty half-hour average-power estimate by 0.5 hours for MWh. The series can be revised. A separate redispatch-volume series remains unverified.
main_caveats: Wind and solar files cover specific ONS operating categories. The figures can change with revisions and do not represent all renewable generation in Brazil.
GNRa is estimated curtailed generation, not redispatch or financial compensation.
The dictionary and tested ENE rows disagree on whether final reference is populated only for REL.
answer.confidence_reason: Both October 2026 CSVs and their dictionaries were tested; redispatch and calculation details remain open.

steps: Download and parse UTF-8 semicolon-delimited CSV.
For the example fields read id_ons, din_instante, id_subsistema, val_geracao, val_geracaoreferencia, val_geracaonaorealizadaapurada, cod_razaorestricao, cod_origemrestricao and id_pontoconexao.
For half-hour MWh, multiply nonempty GNRa values by 0.5 h and sum by id_subsistema, id_pontoconexao and desired period; this is an arithmetic conversion of half-hour average power, not compensation.
For the shown half-hour: 22.52099999999996 × 0.5 = approximately 11.2605 MWh.
October 2026 tested totals, sum of nonempty GNRa × 0.5 h by id_subsistema: NE 2,305,450.069 MWh; S 331,224.0845 MWh; N 28,879.662 MWh; SE 7,074.4 MWh. These are estimates and may change on revision.
reading_traps: Data are revised after publication.
Blank limited-generation field means no limitation in that interval; zero is an explicit zero-generation instruction.
Groups have CEG set to -, so rows are not necessarily individual legal plants.
A curtailment estimate is not the volume of redispatch or compensation.
The dictionary states the final reference is used for external unavailability calculations; do not treat it as the universal counterfactual.
Do not multiply the resulting half-hour energy again by restriction minutes without confirming the data definition.
The dictionary says final reference is calculated only for REL, yet the tested ENE sample also has a value; clarify with ONS before using that field.
Operational routine uses Brasília time (UTC−3); the CSV timestamps themselves have no offset.

The current November CSV was downloaded: its latest timestamp is 2026-11-26 23:30 as checked 27 November. https://ons-aws-prod-opendata.s3.amazonaws.com/dataset/restricao_coff_eolica_tm/RESTRICAO_COFF_EOLICA_2026_11.csv

The latest 20 catalog activity records show changes at 15:xx and 22:xx UTC around 25–27 November; catalog events need not mean observed values changed. https://dados.ons.org.br/api/3/action/package_activity_list?id=restricao_coff_eolica_usi&limit=20
No rate is calculated; missing GNRa entries were excluded, not interpreted as measured zero.
Aggregate either the plant/group series or the corresponding disaggregated records. Adding both levels can double-count the same loss.
